profile.name: UHFQA 超高频量子分析仪
profile.description: 这是一台 Zurich Instruments 的 UHFQA 超高频量子分析仪，用于量子比特读出与高速 IQ 数据采集。该驱动覆盖外部参考时钟同步、默认读出配置加载、AWG 触发采集、结果轮询读取，以及串扰矩阵、相关性、旋转和阈值等读出参数管理。
profile.description_en: This is a Zurich Instruments UHFQA ultra-high-frequency quantum analyzer used for qubit readout and high-speed IQ data acquisition. The driver supports external reference clock synchronization, loading default readout settings, AWG-triggered acquisition, polling and retrieving results, and managing readout parameters such as crosstalk matrices, correlations, rotations, and thresholds.
